{{Top|leg}}
'''Praleena Pring''' was the daughter of [[Dandamont Pring]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General|consul-general]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. 

She had a secret affair with a [[Unidentified Imperial defector|minor bureaucrat]] assigned to [[Consul-General Pring's diplomatic estate|her father's estate]]. She didn't know that her father intended for her to marry [[Unidentified Imperial captain (Dismay)|the captain]] of the ''[[Dismay]]''.

During the soirée where her father announced the engagement—with plans for her to leave in the ''[[Dismay]]'' the next day for the wedding—an [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Rebel]] [[operative]] approached her, saying that her lover invited her to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. She found an oportunity to escape her fate and defied her [[Parent/Legends|father]]. They took advantage of the ensuing confusion (which almost destroyed the party) and had an eventful exit; the guards hesitated to fire at the Rebels while the girl was with them.

While the Captain did not learn that Pring defected to the Rebellion, he was not happy with the development. The Consul-General dismissed the incident as young love, claiming that his daughter would return once she thought things through.
{{Char-stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
The scenario gives the option that the Rebels can escape custody by threatening Dardamont Pring with his life's daughter, pointing a blaster at her; in that case, the Consul-General would order the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] to lower their weapons, giving a window to escape.
